title: AINM Protocol - Transport Schema
description: Transport domain types for the AI-Native Messaging Protocol v0.1.0. Covers the initialize/initialized handshake, capability negotiation, all JSON-RPC method parameters, and error codes. See spec/transport.md.

InitializeParams.description: Parameters for the ainm.initialize request (client -> server). First message after WebSocket upgrade. See transport.md Section 4.3.

protocolVersion.description: Protocol version the client supports. Semantic versioning (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH).

signature.description: Base64url-encoded Ed25519 signature of an initialization nonce for client authentication.

InitializeResult.description: Response to ainm.initialize (server -> client). See transport.md Section 4.3.

protocolVersion.description: Protocol version the server will use for this session.

nonce.description: Server-generated nonce for client authentication verification.

ClientCapabilities.description: Client capabilities declared during ainm.initialize. Only features declared by both client and server are available. See transport.md Section 4.3.

streaming.description: Whether the client supports streaming message delivery.

subThreads.description: Whether the client supports sub-thread operations.

contentTypes.description: Content block types the client can render. Phase 1: text, code, image, file. Phase 2: button, form, table, approval, action.

parallelStreaming.description: Phase 2: Whether the client supports multi-block interleaved streaming deltas. Default false.

toolVisibility.description: Phase 2: Whether the client supports rendering tool call events as collapsible activity indicators.

ServerCapabilities.description: Server capabilities returned during ainm.initialize. See transport.md Section 4.3.

storeAndForward.description: Server queues messages for offline recipients.

maxContentBlocks.description: Maximum number of content blocks per message.

maxMessageSize.description: Maximum message payload size in bytes.

MemoryCapabilities.description: Phase 2 memory tier support. See memory.md.

conversation.description: Supports conversation memory queries via ainm.memory.query.

archival.description: Supports archival memory operations (store, query, evict).

maxContextFrameSize.description: Maximum context frame size in bytes. Recommended default: 32768 (32 KB).

MessageSendParams.description: Parameters for ainm.message.send (client -> server). The signed message envelope. See transport.md Section 4.4.

parent_id.description: Optional parent message ID for sub-threading.

MessageSendResult.description: Response to ainm.message.send. See transport.md Section 4.4.

accepted.description: Whether the server accepted the message for delivery.

MessageDeliverNotification.description: Parameters for ainm.message.deliver (server -> client notification). Delivers a signed message envelope. See transport.md Section 4.4.

ThreadCreateParams.description: Parameters for ainm.thread.create (client -> server). See transport.md Section 4.4.

thread_id.description: UUIDv7 for the new thread. Generated by the client.

parent_thread_id.description: Optional parent thread UUIDv7 for creating sub-threads.

parent_message_id.description: Optional message UUIDv7 indicating the branching point for sub-threads.

participants.description: Initial participant addresses. The creator MUST be included.

ThreadJoinParams.description: Parameters for ainm.thread.join (client -> server). See transport.md Section 4.4.

identity.description: AINM address of the participant joining.

ThreadLeaveParams.description: Parameters for ainm.thread.leave (client -> server). See transport.md Section 4.4.

identity.description: AINM address of the participant leaving.

PresenceUpdateParams.description: Parameters for ainm.presence.update (client -> server notification). See transport.md Section 4.4.

status.description: Presence status. Human: online, offline, away, dnd. Agent: available, busy, processing, offline.

thread_id.description: Optional thread-scoped presence. Omit for global status.

detail.description: Optional human-readable status detail (e.g., 'Fetching weather data from API').

PingResult.description: Response to ainm.ping keepalive. See transport.md Section 4.4.

ShutdownParams.description: Parameters for ainm.shutdown notification (client -> server). See transport.md Section 4.4.

RelayParams.description: Parameters for ainm.relay (server -> server via HTTP POST). See transport.md Section 5.3.

messages.description: Array of signed message envelopes to relay.

from_server.description: Originating server identifier (matches server_id in server identity response).

relay_timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when relay payload was created. Receivers reject if older than 5 minutes.

relay_id.description: Unique identifier for this relay payload. Used for replay deduplication.

server_signature.description: Server-level Ed25519 signature of the relay payload (JCS-canonicalized params without this field). relay_timestamp and relay_id are included in the signed payload.

RelayResult.description: Response to ainm.relay. See transport.md Section 5.3.

accepted.description: Number of messages accepted for delivery.

BackfillParams.description: Parameters for ainm.backfill (server -> origin server via HTTP POST). See transport.md Section 5.5.

thread_id.description: Thread ID to request history for.

after_sequence.description: Cursor: return messages with sequence > this value.

limit.description: Maximum messages to return per page.

BackfillResult.description: Response to ainm.backfill. See transport.md Section 5.5.

messages.description: Array of message envelopes in sequence order.

has_more.description: True if more messages exist after this page.

next_cursor.description: Sequence number to use as after_sequence for next page. Present only when has_more is true.

ContextPushParams.description: Parameters for ainm.context-push (origin server -> remote server via HTTP POST). See transport.md Section 5.6.

thread_id.description: Thread ID for which context frames are being pushed.

context_frames.description: Array of active context frames to deliver to the remote server.

from_server.description: Origin server's identifier (matches server_id in server identity response).

server_signature.description: Base64url-encoded Ed25519 signature of JCS-canonicalized params (with server_signature excluded).

ContextFrame.description: A single context frame representing active memory state. See memory.md.

frame_type.description: Frame type. Currently only 'active_context' is supported for context-push.

data.description: The context frame data. Structure depends on key.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when this context frame was created or last updated.

ContextPushResult.description: Response to ainm.context-push. See transport.md Section 5.6.

accepted.description: True if context frames were accepted for delivery to local agents.

TransportErrorCodes.description: Transport-related JSON-RPC error codes. See transport.md Section 3.6 and Section 7.

const.name: UnsupportedProtocolVersion
const.description: Client and server protocol versions are incompatible

const.name: NotInitialized
const.description: Method called before initialization handshake completed

const.name: RateLimited
const.description: Too many requests from client or relay source

const.name: NotAParticipant
const.description: Sender is not a member of the specified thread

const.name: ReplayDetected
const.description: Relay payload failed replay protection (stale timestamp or duplicate relay_id)

const.name: AlreadyAParticipant
const.description: Identity is already a member of the thread
